purpose: Create portable stateful software and game systems from typed programs, explicit control graphs, scenarios and bounded invariant exploration.

properties.path: New ordinary output directory, outside machine internals.
properties.request: Explicit build, verify or retain code-system request; includes typed job and axm.code-system/v0.1 contract.

relationships: Composes bundled code-profession procedures and Grammar 102 with the existing UC deterministic state graph; exposes original source and scoped executable evidence.
limitations: JavaScript and Python only; model is an explicit typed record, and effects remain data for an external host.
Exploration covers declared concrete events through a specified depth; exhausted budgets and counterexamples hold verification.
No arbitrary source execution, automatic natural-language synthesis, rendered game/UI quality, external side-effect verification, balance or whole-program proof.
Runtime execution uses fixed local processes and time/output bounds, not an OS sandbox. Restore replays checkpoints but does not authenticate them.
Retention preserves explicitly verified construction without automatic shared machine mutation or canon promotion.
